title: Re-exporting Module Items
goal: Expose nested items at the module root using re-exports.

sections.text: You import symbols into a module scope with `use`. Adding `pub` before `use` re-exports that symbol for external callers.

sections.caption: `pub use` makes `Config` accessible directly from this module.

sections.text: Re-exporting hides complex folder structures from consumers. Callers import clean paths without knowing your internal module organization.

sections.caption: Callers use the shorter top-level path.

sections.text: Without `pub`, a `use` statement brings a symbol in privately. Outer callers cannot reach private imports and will trigger `E0603`.

explanation: Expose nested items at the module root using re-exports.
